objectives.text: Ryftborne: Shadows of the Void is an augmented reality game developed by ZenLuv AI Inc.
The funding goal for Ryftborne: Shadows of the Void was $49,641.
$776 was pledged towards the funding goal.
The funding period for the project was from September 7, 2025, to October 7, 2025.
The project was last updated on October 7, 2025.
Ryftborne: Shadows of the Void is categorized under Mobile Games.
Ryftborne is presented as a social augmented reality (AR) experience.
Users can spot creatures in the real world using their phones.
Ryftborne allows users to take selfies, videos, and dances with creatures in a TikTok-style format.
The initial launch of Ryftborne is referred to as the MVP (Minimum Viable Product).
At MVP release, users will experience core AR gameplay where they can see Ryfts open in real-world AR.
The Game Mode (Lite) allows users to approach and capture Ryftborne creatures in their environment.
Creator Mode (Lite) enables users to place a hero or monster in their space and record selfies and short videos.
Users can share their Ryftborne captures directly to TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube Shorts.
The MVP will feature 6 fully animated characters, including 3 heroes and 3 monsters.
Backer Beta will provide early access testing for supporters before the public release.
Ryftborne aims to create a working, playable AR experience with real characters and shareability.
Ryftborne allows users to record selfies and short videos.
Users can post their Ryftborne captures straight to TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube Shorts.
The MVP of Ryftborne is a working, playable AR experience with real characters, captures, and shareability.
$120K stretch goal will expand the launch roster to 10 heroes and 10 monsters with advanced animations.
$225K stretch goal will introduce a Text-to-3D Creator that allows users to type a prompt and spawn a character.
$300K stretch goal will enable users to upload and sell custom 3D models with built-in royalties.
$400K stretch goal will allow for multiplayer AR encounters with up to 4 players.
$500K stretch goal will introduce Persistent Anchors and Remote Encounters worldwide.
The development roadmap for Ryftborne includes a core AR engine and basic Game & Creator Modes in the first 3 months.
In month 4, 6 launch characters and social sharing features will be added.
A closed beta for backers only is scheduled for month 5.
The public launch on iOS and Android is planned for months 6-7.
Stretch goal features will be added after launch, with monthly updates to backers.
The team has built buffer into their schedule and will run closed beta testing to ensure stability before launch.
For stretch goals involving user-generated content, there will be a clear moderation policy and review system.
Mobile development can face unexpected delays, and the team will provide monthly updates to backers.
